headline_definitions.operational_definition: Count of unique registered records returned by the declared ClinicalTrials.gov query, equal to the API totalCount for that query; may include expanded-access records when availability statuses are requested.
Canonical report sentence stating that registered-record counts do not measure unique agents, assets, or development programs.
Records with study_type EXPANDED_ACCESS, returned when expanded-access availability statuses are included in the declared query.
Records assigned a trial phase (Phase 1 through Phase 4, including combined phases).
Records with no applicable phase (Not Applicable), which includes observational and many device/diagnostic studies.
Top-level report alias of match_evidence.descriptions_available_count: retrieved records with at least one ClinicalTrials.gov intervention description present.
Top-level report alias of match_evidence.brief_summary_available_count: retrieved records with a ClinicalTrials.gov brief summary present.
Top-level report alias of match_evidence.detailed_description_available_count: retrieved records with a ClinicalTrials.gov detailed description present.
Count of unique normalized lead-sponsor names across retrieved records.
Retrieved records whose ClinicalTrials.gov lead-sponsor class is INDUSTRY; this is a record count, not a unique-sponsor count.
Retrieved records whose lead-sponsor class is not INDUSTRY; this is a record count, not a unique-sponsor count.
Interventional records whose study purpose could not be resolved from the available record fields; labeled, never assigned an invented modality.
